g.text: 03 Agents, tool selection and bounded execution
MERMAID adaptation: a compact typed claim plan guides an Executor that alternates source retrieval and evidence-grounded judgment.
Use statement, plan and recalled passages.
Automatic search across all three filings.
Merge unique passage IDs into context.
Count retrieval as one logical tool call.
JSON argument schemas; chooses a call.
then search a gap or submit_verdict.
For submit_verdict: run the evidence gate.
observations / errors are appended; next model request sees the accumulated state
Default total across both agents: 8 model calls / 16 tool calls.
Final slot, or two searches with no new evidence: submit-only.
Valid candidate → complete. Exhaustion / model failure / repeated
unstructured output → incomplete with an explicit stop_reason.
The model selects named tools; Python executes them.
Malformed plan → fall back to original statement.
Bad arguments, missing passage or rejected quote → error feedback.
One format reminder; retries remain inside the same budgets.
Ollama client: qwen3.5:9b, temperature 0, think=False, 8,192-token context, up to 1,800 output tokens, 120-second request timeout. Calls and retries are counted.
